result.instructions: Tools for CourtReserve, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which courts are free tomorrow evening between 6 and 9 pm?"; "Which memberships end in the next 30 days, and who has not booked a court in a month?"; "How many people are registered for Saturday's pickleball clinic, and who is on the waitlist?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CourtReserve data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run courtreserve_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run courtreserve_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run courtreserve_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. courtreserve_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the club's members (name, email, phone, membership type and status, start/end/next payment dates, family id). Filter by member id, family, exact email, phone or the created (at most 30 days) / created-or-updated (at most 31 days) time. Paged: pass next_page back as page. PIN codes and SSO links are not returned. Needs the Member role (Read). GET /api/v1/member/get.

family_id.description: Only the members of this family (organizationMemberFamilyId).

created_from.description: Only members created at or after this club-local date-time (with created_to: at most 30 days apart).

created_to.description: Only members created at or before this club-local date-time.

created_or_updated_from.description: Only members created or changed at or after this club-local date-time (with the end: at most 31 days apart).

created_or_updated_to.description: Only members created or changed at or before this club-local date-time.

include_ratings.description: Add skill ratings (DUPR, UTR and so on).

include_marketing_consent.description: Add current email/text opt-in and the consent history.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: courtreserve_get_member_reservations
tools.title: Get a member's reservations
tools.description: A member's upcoming (or dated) court bookings and event registrations: type, start/end, courts, event name and players. For a family member the reply covers the whole family. Give the member id or your own external id. Needs the Member role (Read). GET /api/v1/member/reservations.

organization_member_id.description: CourtReserve member id (courtreserve_list_members). One of this or external_id is required.

external_id.description: The member's id in your own system (the member's External Id).

start_date.description: Only reservations ending on or after this club-local date/time (default: now).

end_date.description: Only reservations ending on or before this club-local date/time (default: open-ended).

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_families
tools.title: List families
tools.description: List family accounts (family id, name, number, members and membership). Needs the Family role (Read). GET /api/v1/family/get.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_membership_types
tools.title: List membership types
tools.description: The club's membership types (id, name, price, billing and status). Use the ids to filter the membership report. Needs the MembershipType role (Read). GET /api/v1/membershiptype/get.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_membership_report
tools.title: Membership report
tools.description: The Membership report: one row per member or family membership with status, billing cadence, start/end, next payment and cancellation history. Filter by type, assignment (family or individual) and the start, end, next-payment or cancellation dates. Paged. Needs the Membership Report role (Read). GET /api/v1/membershipreport/list.

assignment_type.description: Only family or only individual memberships (default both).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_courts
tools.title: List courts
tools.description: The club's courts: id, label, court type and order. Use the ids in court utilization and court blocks. Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/courts.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_reservation_types
tools.title: List reservation types
tools.description: The club's reservation types (court booking, lesson, court block and so on) with ids. Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/reservationtypes.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_get_court_availability
tools.title: Get court availability
tools.description: Court availability: each court's operating hours and the time slots already booked, for one date or a date range of at most 31 days (time zone of the club in the reply). Needs the Reservation role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservation/availability.

date.description: One date, yyyy-MM-dd. Use this OR from_date + to_date.

from_date.description: First date of a range, yyyy-MM-dd.

to_date.description: Last date of the range, yyyy-MM-dd (at most 31 days after from_date).

court_type_id.description: Only courts of this type (see the court type in courtreserve_list_courts).

tools.name: courtreserve_list_reservations
tools.title: List active reservations
tools.description: Active court reservations for a reservation period (the dates played) or a created/updated period, at most 31 days each: type, courts, start/end, players with contact details and what they owe/paid. Give at least one period. PIN codes are not returned. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/listactive.

created_or_updated_from.description: Reservations created or changed on or after.

created_or_updated_to.description: Reservations created or changed on or before.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_cancelled_reservations
tools.title: List cancelled reservations
tools.description: Cancelled court reservations by the date they were cancelled or by the reservation period, at most 31 days each. Give at least one period. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/listcancelled.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_whos_here
tools.title: Who is here
tools.description: Who is booked in a time window (for example today): member reservations and event registrations with the member, court and time, optionally including or only cancelled ones. The window can be at most 31 days. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/whoisheretoday.

start.description: Start of the window, club-local yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.

end.description: End of the window, club-local yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_court_utilization
tools.title: Court utilization
tools.description: Court utilization report (booked vs available time per time slot) for a period of at most 7 days, optionally for chosen courts, court types, event types, event tags or reservation types. Needs the ReservationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/reservationreport/courtutilization.

end_date.description: Last day of the period (at most 7 days after the first).

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_categories
tools.title: List event categories
tools.description: Event categories (clinics, round robins, tournaments, open play...) with ids. Needs the EventCalendar role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventcalendar/categories.

is_public.description: Only public (true) or only non-public (false) categories; omit for all.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: Events on the club calendar between two dates: name, category, start/end, courts, instructors, capacity, registered and waitlist counts, price and rating limits. SSO links are not returned. Needs the EventCalendar role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventcalendar/eventlist.

end_date.description: Events up to this club-local date/time.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_registrations
tools.title: List event registrations
tools.description: Active registrations for events, clinics and lessons with the member, event and what was paid. Give an event period or a registration period, at most 31 days each. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listactive.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_event_waitlist
tools.title: List event waitlist
tools.description: People on event waitlists. Give an event period or a registration period, at most 31 days each. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listwaitlist.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_cancelled_event_registrations
tools.title: List cancelled event registrations
tools.description: Cancelled event registrations by cancellation date or by event date, at most 31 days each. Give at least one period. Needs the EventRegistrationReport role (Read). GET /api/v1/eventregistrationreport/listcancelled.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_checkins
tools.title: List check-ins
tools.description: Check-in report: who checked in to court bookings and events, by check-in period or reservation period (at most 31 days each). Give at least one period. Role: the key's access to attendance data. GET /api/v1/attendancereport/checkin.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: Transactions (fees, membership fees, payments, refunds...) by transaction date or reservation date: id, type, date, subtotal, tax, total, unpaid amount, payment type, category and the member's name, email and phone. Filter by type, paid/unpaid and payment type. Give at least one period. Needs the Transactions role (Read). GET /api/v1/transactions/list.

transaction_types.description: Comma-separated transaction types, for example 'Fee,Membership Fee,Payment' (the vendor's own names).

payment_types.description: Comma-separated payment types, for example 'Cash,Credit Card,Balance'.

include_promo_info.description: Add the promo codes each fee used.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_sales_summary
tools.title: Sales summary
tools.description: Detailed sales summary for a payment period of at most 31 days: paid fees plus refunds by category and payment type. Needs the Transactions role (Read). GET /api/v1/transactions/salessummarydetailed.

payment_from.description: First day of the payment period.

payment_to.description: Last day of the payment period (at most 31 days after the first).

include_promo_info.description: Add the promo codes each fee used.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_promo_codes
tools.title: List promo codes
tools.description: The club's promo codes: code, name, type, value, dates, limits and what they apply to. Needs the PromoCodes role (Read). GET /api/v1/promocode/get.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default 100, max 500). The reply says when rows were left out.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_leagues
tools.title: List leagues
tools.description: The club's leagues, with their sessions (id and name) when include_sessions is true (default). Paged. Needs the League role (Read). GET /api/v1/league/get.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: courtreserve_list_league_sessions
tools.title: List league sessions
tools.description: League sessions, for one league or one session, optionally with their game days and registered players. Paged. Needs the League role (Read). GET /api/v1/league/sessions.

include_players.description: Add each session's registered players (use with one session).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.
